answer: Protocol escrow holds every reward a young account earns for 2 + N/5 epochs, where N is the network-wide newcomer cohort. Unvested funds are no haven, since one fraud proof burns them. A farm spread over a meadow of 50 keys pushes vesting to 12 epochs, and the k-th key stretches the lock on all k balances, so each next fake costs more. Elapsed epochs cannot be bought, shared or precomputed, so a rising tide of fakes freezes the attacker's own capital.
